chapter: Race, critics and the big bands
title: Family bands: the Pettifords and Slide Hampton's band
summary: Sam did not hear the Pettiford family band but often heard Slide Hampton's family band stuck in Florida.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you hear him with his family band?
Because they tell me that his whole family played music too. He started out with a band that was made up of members of his family.
They all played, his sisters, mother, father and all of them. But I didn't hear them. The only family band I heard was the Slide Hampton band.
I heard them a lot. In fact I heard them a whole lot. Because they stayed down in Florida for a while. For quite a while they couldn't even get out of there. Had to stand it in there.
